reading.field: z_c = keep(z_0 + a (z - z_0)): z the network's field at the level's D, z_0 its field at base_level_mm, keep the contact unknowns set to at least zero
reading.amplitude: a minimises the training energy (float32, c2.torch_energy) of z_c at the level's D over a_min <= a <= a_max: a safeguarded secant iteration on dPi/da from a = 1, at most max_evaluations energy evaluations, stopped at |dPi/da| <= rtol Pi; the evaluated point of lowest energy is returned
reading.labels: none: no reference solution enters a reading
